categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds a new fuzz harness in `src/test/fuzz/musig.cpp` and updates build targets, matching the Fuzzing label and explicit coverage of fuzzing harnesses in this category.
categories.rationale: Adds dedicated fuzzing coverage for the `src/musig` module to exercise error paths and malformed input handling. As noted in review, the signing functions previously lacked unit tests and had only functional test coverage, making this a worthwhile addition to fuzz coverage without touching critical consensus or p2p code paths.
